scope: Bind an already-produced parameter-family proposal to at most one still-valid local eligibility carrier per family without computing or applying a parameter update.

bootstrap_bias.purpose: shorten early graph-shaping search and provide an interpretable fixed baseline

parameter_families.node-input-gate: expressed flagged node with an input port
parameter_families.node-output-gate: expressed flagged node with an output port
parameter_families.node-trace-gate: expressed flagged node with a trace port

selection.threshold: configured minimum absolute eligibility within the existing eligibility clip
selection.tie_break: lowest stable node or edge ID

persisted: event has any bound target flag
per-family bound flag and role-neutral reason code
target kind, slot index and stable node or edge ID
not_persisted: complete node or edge execution path
reward, valence, polarity, trust or interest

compatibility.v0114_checkpoint: upgrade allocates empty binding metadata without fabricating targets
compatibility.birth: newborn event ring and pending target metadata start empty
compatibility.clone_checkpoint_compaction: committed bounded binding metadata is copied exactly
compatibility.death: binding metadata is cleared with the row

forbidden: using current-tick activity as its own historical target
treating fixed single-winner selection as the only valid attention mechanism
multiplying proposal and eligibility into a final update in Stage 3C-1
claiming bound proposals as causal credit, learning or subjecthood
